statement: Russian forces strike Kyiv with missiles or drones at least once between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-18, confirmed by Ukrainian officials and carried by a major international wire service.
resolution: Reuters, AP, or AFP and at least one Ukrainian government source report a Russian missile or drone strike on Kyiv occurring between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-18.
failure_condition: No Russian missile or drone strike on Kyiv occurs between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-18.

statement: United States forces conduct military strikes on targets inside Iranian territory between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: The US Department of Defense or the President announces US strikes on targets inside Iran conducted between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-30, and Iranian state media acknowledge strikes occurred.
failure_condition: The window closes with no US military strike conducted against targets inside Iranian territory.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle above 100.00 US dollars on at least one trading day between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: The official ICE Brent front-month daily settlement price exceeds 100.00 US dollars on at least one trading day between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-30.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-30 is at or below 100.00 US dollars.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee announces no change to the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting concluding 2026-09-16.
resolution: The FOMC statement and implementation note released 2026-09-16 on federalreserve.gov announce the federal funds target range is unchanged from the prior meeting.
failure_condition: The 2026-09-16 FOMC statement announces a raised or lowered federal funds target range.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog gains at least 12 entries with dateAdded values between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
resolution: The public CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least 12 entries whose dateAdded field falls between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Fewer than 12 KEV entries carry a dateAdded value between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-30.

statement: A vulnerability in a GitLab product is added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog contains at least one entry listing GitLab as vendor or product with dateAdded between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming GitLab carries a dateAdded value between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-31.

statement: A petition challenging the 2026 Zambian presidential election result is filed with the Constitutional Court of Zambia between 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-04.
resolution: Constitutional Court of Zambia records or at least two international wire services report a petition challenging the presidential result was filed between 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-04.
failure_condition: No petition challenging the presidential result is filed with the Constitutional Court between 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-04.

statement: A jury verdict is returned or a mistrial is declared between 2026-08-18 and 2026-11-30 in the Nevada trial over the 1996 killing of Tupac Shakur.
resolution: Nevada court records or at least two major wire services report a jury verdict returned or a mistrial declared in the Tupac Shakur murder trial between 2026-08-18 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: Neither a jury verdict nor a declared mistrial occurs in the case between 2026-08-18 and 2026-11-30.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.5 or greater with an epicenter in Indonesia occurring between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-31 UTC.
resolution: The USGS ComCat catalog lists at least one event of magnitude 6.5 or greater located within Indonesia with origin time between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-31 UTC.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog contains no Indonesia event of magnitude 6.5 or greater with origin time between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-31 UTC.

statement: The GDACS alert level for tropical cyclone SEVENTEEN-26 reaches Orange or Red between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-01.
resolution: The GDACS event page for tropical cyclone SEVENTEEN-26, event id 1001305, shows an Orange or Red alert issued between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-01.
failure_condition: The GDACS alert level for event id 1001305 remains Green or lower through 2026-09-01.
